content:
Apple's newly launched iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max series opened for pre-order today, several days ahead of their official release date on September 18.

As of Saturday evening, shipping dates for some models had already been pushed back to October—especially the iPhone 18 Pro Max.

Below are the latest estimated shipping dates for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. This data only reflects estimated delivery dates and does not account for in-store pickup, as availability can vary significantly across different markets.

iPhone 18 Pro

256GB 512GB 1TB 2TB Burgundy Sept 24-29 Sept 24-29 Sept 18 Sept 18 Glacier Sept 18 Sept 18 Sept 18 Sept 18 Black Sept 18 Sept 18 Sept 18 Sept 18 Silver Sept 18 Sept 18 Sept 18 Sept 18

iPhone 18 Pro Max

256GB 512GB 1TB 2TB Burgundy Oct 6-13 Oct 6-13 Oct 6-13 Sept 18 Glacier Oct 6-13 Oct 6-13 Sept 24-29 Sept 18 Black Oct 6-13 Sept 24-29 Sept 18 Sept 18 Silver Oct 6-13 Oct 6-13 Sept 18 Sept 18

As you can see, the iPhone 18 Pro is well-stocked across nearly all configurations and can be delivered in time for the release date. However, supply for the iPhone 18 Pro Max is much tighter.

Regardless of whether it's the iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max, the 2TB configuration in all colours can still achieve same-day delivery. So, if you're willing to spend a bit more, you can still pick your preferred colour and screen size right now.

A few points worth noting—this year's iPhone launch differs from recent years because there's also the iPhone Duo coming right after. Apple's first foldable iPhone won't open for pre-order until October 16, with an official release date set for October 23. Some buyers may want to wait for that device before deciding whether to place an order.
